purpose: Define the deterministic binding from structural future-space profiles, domains and operationalisations to successor states, realized transformations and T_acc before implementation.

transition_rule.rule: Apply every profile dimension explicitly according to the selected domain and operationalisation binding; each dimension must produce a traceable structural component in the realized transformation.

t_acc_rule.definition: All valid one-step structural transformations obtainable from S_t+1 by applying every action A/B/C/D with every profile slot under the same domain and operationalisation binding.

blocking_rule: No fixture freeze or scientific execution is authorized until simulator and independent reconstruction both implement this binding and pass semantic completeness and parity preflights.
